meta.name: firebase-basics
meta.description: Provides foundational Firebase CLI setup, CLI installation, version checks (`firebase-tools@latest --version`), CLI login (including --no-localhost), project creation, project selection (`firebase use`), and app config file downloads (`google-services.json`, `GoogleService-Info.plist`). Use ONLY for CLI login, project creation/switching, or downloading app config files. Don't use for Firebase Hosting deploy, Firestore, Auth, App Hosting, Data Connect, Crashlytics, or Remote Config.

copy.tagline: 搭建 Firebase 开发环境,管理项目与配置文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚开始接触 Firebase,需要快速完成项目环境配置。
copy.tagline_en: Set up Firebase CLI, create projects, and download config files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to Firebase and need to configure your project environment quickly.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先检查 Firebase CLI 是否安装、是否已登录，然后帮你创建或切换 Firebase 项目。它也能用命令行把 Android 和 iOS 的应用配置文件取到本地，而不是让你去控制台下载。
howto.when: 当你需要登录 Firebase CLI、创建或切换项目，或下载应用配置文件（google-services.json 等）时接管；Hosting 部署、Firestore、Auth 等不在它范围内。

say.text: 用 npx 查一下 Firebase CLI 的版本
帮我登录 Firebase，浏览器打不开就用 --no-localhost
say.note: 登录后命令会输出当前用户

say.text: 帮我切换到这个 Firebase 项目 ID

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude checks whether the Firebase CLI is installed and logged in, then helps create or switch Firebase projects. It also fetches Android and iOS app config files via the CLI instead of sending you to the console.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to log in to the Firebase CLI, create or switch projects, or download app config files such as google-services.json. It does not cover Hosting deploy, Firestore, or Auth.

say_en.text: Check the Firebase CLI version with npx
Log me in to Firebase, use --no-localhost if the browser fails
say_en.note: The command outputs the current user

say_en.text: Switch me to this Firebase project ID
say_en.note: Runs firebase use <PROJECT_ID> and confirms the active project
